answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each new identity to a bond escrowed by established peers: the newcomer's fee rests on a public ledge of unproven accounts, and proven fraud burns that stake plus a slice of every vouching peer's collateral. Reputation then seasons like timber - only after many honest attestation cycles does it gain load-bearing weight, so mass-registered clones can never cheaply fabricate the structural credit a profitable attack would require.
